title: Reproducible code: registry-recorded gestational violence and neonatal outcomes at HGOIA, 2009–2024
description: R code, aggregate results and a conceptual DAG for analyses of registry-recorded gestational violence and neonatal outcomes at Hospital Gineco-Obstétrico Isidro Ayora, Quito, Ecuador. The release includes Bayesian, Firth, quantitative bias, inverse-probability-weighting and E-value analyses. It contains no individual-level clinical data.
